children.text: Hostel facility for all Boys/ Girls Boarders studying upto XII Standard.

schemeContent.benefits_md: - **Accommodation:** Hostel facility for all Boys/ Girls Boarders studying upto XII Standard.
schemeContent.briefDescription: The scheme provides hostel facilities to all boys and girls boarders studying up to XII Standard.

children.text: The scheme “Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department-Hostels: Special Guides” by the Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department, Tamil Nadu, aims to offer hostel accommodations to students belonging to the Adi Dravidar and Tribal communities. The initiative supports their education by ensuring a safe and structured environment for studying, addressing the housing needs of students from underprivileged backgrounds. The facilities are available for students up to the XII Standard.

The initiative supports their education by ensuring a safe and structured environment for studying, addressing the housing needs of students from underprivileged backgrounds.
